defense_news.title: Disrupt, Strike, Assault and Endure: The 4 pillars of the US Army’s new warfare guidance
defense_news.summary: “How The Army Fights” is a new 46-page U.S. Army-issued guide on how the service should fight — and survive — on the modern battlefield.

defense_news.title: European officials weigh mix of high-tech drones and heavy armor
defense_news.summary: European leaders are figuring out the right mix between unmanned systems and heavy armor to secure NATO's eastern flank.

defense_news.title: ‘You’re a coward’: Protesters heckle Hegseth during AUSA panel
defense_news.summary: Protesters derailed a Washington, D.C., panel featuring Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Wednesday, calling him a “war criminal” and “Nazi.”

defense_news.title: US Army generals propose larger-footprint, more frequent military exercises in Korea
defense_news.summary: After Trump scaled back a joint exercise with South Korea, a U.S. Army commander called for more frequent drills modeled on lessons from Ukraine.

geo_news.title: İstanbul'da metro, tramvay ve füniküler hatlarında seferler saat 02.00'ye kadar uzatıldı
geo_news.summary: İstanbul'da etkili olan yoğun yağış ve olumsuz hava koşulları nedeniyle bazı metro, tramvay ve füniküler hatlarında seferlerin saat 02.00'ye kadar uzatıldığı bildirildi.
